verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents running your own rendezvous/relay server, with a compose file for the OSS server and clients that connect peer-to-peer or fall back to your relay. Independent users report running their own lookup/relay servers for years or via Docker successfully. Some users found self-hosting hard or laggy, but these reports do not concretely refute the capability. Missing for 10: authentication on the OSS self-hosted server (reportedly Pro-only), encryption on self-hosted setups by default (per one report), and in-depth first-party setup documentation in the pack.
